# `redundant-qualified-name`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: official · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a nested type name that repeats its containing namespace.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Call sites already qualify the type, so repetition produces names such as
`http.HttpRequest` without adding meaning.

## When it fires

It applies when the shorter suffix remains clear within the containing
namespace.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Parser = struct {
    const ParserError = error{Bad};
};
```

Reference: <https://ziglang.org/documentation/master/#Avoid-Redundant-Names-in-Fully-Qualified-Namespaces>
